_doc: Merge the `claude` entry into .agents.providers in ~/.paseo/config.json once per machine; it holds the token every Claude seat inherits through `extends`.
The SLUG entries are templates: setup/add-project.fish copies them for each project, replacing SLUG and HOME_DIR and adding env.SEATWORKS_REPO (and env.SEATWORKS_KIT for the Supervisor).
Merge into the existing file; don't replace it, because it also holds workspaces and the agent ledger.
Also make sure .daemon.mcp has "enabled": true and "injectIntoAgents": true, or the Lead and Supervisor get no Paseo tools.
Replace OAUTH_TOKEN with your CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. add-project.fish drops it from the seat entries when the base `claude` entry has one.
Delete the _doc key before writing: Paseo's schema rejects unknown keys.
